shared_elements: monumental standing pillar/figure carved in low relief
paired, mirrored motifs at the top
stacked registers of motifs down the shaft
justification: Both are tall standing monolithic forms whose surfaces carry shallow, schematic relief organised in stacked registers, with a prominent circular disc/ring motif in the middle zone, bird-like creatures in profile, and symmetrically paired motifs across the upper part. The biggest difference is that B is explicitly anthropomorphic (a body with head, shoulders and arms wrapping the block, with the carvings functioning as ornament on a back), whereas A is an abstract rectangular slab bearing a narrative-like frieze of distinct animals, snakes, herringbone bands and a small kneeling figure holding a disc, with no unifying body form.
